clue.text: MCC pictures to be shifted? Careful!

indicators.note: letters that are to be shifted are moved about into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone warns the Marylebone Cricket Club to take care when moving its paintings.
explanation.walkthrough: MCC is the Marylebone Cricket Club, the historic owner of Lord's cricket ground in London; here its three letters simply join PICTURES as fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone circumspect is wary and prudent, taking care before acting.

clue.text: It's firmly placed in one's memory

definitions.text: It's firmly placed in one's memory

parts.words: It's firmly placed in one's memory
parts.note: reads like a fact fixed in the mind, but means a solid monument erected in remembrance of someone, especially the war dead

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase 'in one's memory' shifts from mental recall to commemoration: a stone memorial set firmly in the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A war memorial is a monument built in honour of the dead, typically those buried elsewhere.

clue.text: Man at peak in middle of trick? It could be to impress

indicators.note: one piece goes in another, here inside the centre letters of the word trick
middle of asks for the letters of trick without its first and last

parts.note: HE is the pronoun for a man
a tor is a rocky hilltop peak, as on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: A man stands on a summit in the middle of some trickery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'middle of' strips the outer letters from trick; a tor is a rocky hill typical of south-west England, and 'at' just links the man to the peak.
explanation.definitionFit: Oratory or persuasive language is often used just to sway and impress listeners.

clue.text: At college the aim is to alter greatly

parts.note: in British usage a student who is up is in residence at university
an end is a goal or aim

explanation.surface: A student's goal while at university is to transform things.
explanation.walkthrough: Being 'up' at Oxford or Cambridge means being in residence there as a student.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn something upside down is to overturn or transform it radically.

clue.text: Thus affected I can be heard in sleep

indicators.note: affected means altered, so the letters of thus are rearranged
can be heard says the letter I is to be taken as spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: said aloud, these words sound like EYE

explanation.surface: Someone speaking in an affected manner can be overheard while napping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affected' rearranges THUS into SHUT; 'can be heard' turns the letter I into its sound-alike EYE.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal term for a nap or a period of sleep.

clue.text: Restricted to an area Med, Nice, perhaps?

indicators.note: perhaps signals that the letters could be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: Something seems confined to one region, maybe the Mediterranean or the city of Nice.
explanation.walkthrough: MED and NICE together give the seven letters to rearrange; the question mark marks the playful surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A disease or species found only in a particular region or population is described this way.

clue.text: Sailor man in oilskin hat

parts.note: a tar is an old word for a sailor
Paul is a man's name

explanation.surface: A seaman wears a waterproof hat.
explanation.walkthrough: TAR for sailor is a crossword staple; any man's name can be wanted, here PAUL.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarred or waterproofed sailor's hat was traditionally called by this name, as well as the sheet of canvas.

clue.text: Loud advert seen to be in fashion

parts.note: F is forte, the musical direction for loud
an ad is short for an advertisement

explanation.surface: A noisy commercial is shown to be trendy.
explanation.definitionFit: A craze or short-lived fashion.

clue.text: Tart, say, served up as an addition to the main item

definitions.text: an addition to the main item

parts.note: a flan is an open tart

indicators.note: in a down clue, served up means the letters are written upwards

parts.note: e.g. means for example, so say

explanation.surface: A pastry dessert is served as an extra beside the main course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'served up' reverses EG to GE beneath FLAN in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A projecting rim or collar attached to a pipe or wheel, an addition to the main part.

clue.text: It's over-elaborate to come into line at the Yard

parts.note: dress is the military command for soldiers to align themselves in ranks

explanation.surface: It's too much to fall in line at Scotland Yard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dress' as a drill term means to align troops in a straight rank.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothing that is fancy or showy is described as overdone and elaborate.

clue.text: A relation of English in a French city

indicators.note: in places one piece within the city name

parts.note: Nice is a city on the French Riviera

explanation.surface: Someone has an English relative living in a city in France.
explanation.definitionFit: A brother's or sister's daughter is a family relation.

clue.text: Lower class to treat as inferior

parts.note: under means lower or beneath
a rate is a class or grade, as in first-rate

explanation.surface: Snobs look down on the lower classes.
explanation.definitionFit: To undervalue something is to judge it lower than it deserves.

clue.text: Men originally not hired to work in this port?

indicators.note: to work means the letters are worked over into a new order
originally picks the opening letter of men

explanation.surface: Asks whether men who weren't hired at first went to work in a harbour town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to work' rearranges NOTHIRED into TRONDHEI; 'originally' adds the opening letter of Men at the end. The port is in Norway.
explanation.definitionFit: Norway's third city is a seaport on a fjord.

clue.text: Giant butterfly

definitions.meaning: in Greek myth a hundred-eyed giant set to guard Io
a family of small brown or blue butterflies bears the same name

explanation.definitionFit: The many-eyed monster of Greek legend, and also a kind of brown butterfly named after him.

clue.text: Piano that's likely to be adaptable?

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for soft
liable means likely to do something

explanation.surface: A piano that might be adapted to new uses.
explanation.definitionFit: Flexible or easily bent and influenced.

clue.text: This joke could be over one's head

definitions.text: This joke could be over one's head

parts.words: This joke could be over one's head
parts.note: reads like a gag too subtle to understand, but means a prank such as a bucket balanced over a door to fall on someone

explanation.definitionFit: A practical joke trap, like a bucket of water above a door, literally sits over the victim's head.

clue.text: Select the boat first to go

indicators.note: first to go removes the opening letter of the boat word

parts.note: a scull is a small light rowing boat

explanation.surface: Someone picks out the boat that should leave first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first to go' drops S from SCULL.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick out and remove certain animals from a herd, or selectively gather.

clue.text: Difficulty, in first class transport, to get a lift outside town

indicators.note: in a down clue, getting a lift means all the letters are read upwards

parts.note: A1 means first class, with the 1 read as I

indicators.note: in puts the difficulty inside the vehicle word

parts.note: a bus is public transport
a rub is a difficulty, as in there's the rub

explanation.surface: A struggle in a first-class vehicle to hitch a lift out of town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get a lift' turns the whole assembled run upwards, since this is a down entry; A1 is a common British phrase for first-rate.
explanation.definitionFit: The residential districts on the edge of a city.

clue.text: Tease the eccentric arty type

indicators.note: eccentric means odd, so the letters are rearranged oddly

explanation.surface: Someone mocks the odd artistic sort.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with a refined, perhaps affected, appreciation of art and beauty.

clue.text: Short blast to and fro

indicators.note: fro, the opposite of to, means the word is read going back the other way

explanation.surface: A brief horn sound echoes back and forth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to and fro' gives TO forwards and then, with 'fro', backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief hoot from a horn or whistle.

clue.text: A cut for the league champions?

definitions.meaning: a joint of beef from the upper thigh
playfully, the team at the top of the table

explanation.definitionFit: A lean beef joint from the hindquarter, and humorously the leading team.

clue.text: Damage certain books in the firm's service

indicators.note: in places the books inside the other pieces

parts.note: Co. is short for company, a firm
use means service, as in of use
NT is the New Testament, a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Some books were damaged while in a company's service.
explanation.definitionFit: To bruise, injuring without breaking the skin.

clue.text: City once possibly holding the record

indicators.note: holding means one piece contains the other
possibly signals that the letters of once may be arranged otherwise

parts.note: a log is a record, as in a ship's log

explanation.surface: A city that may once have been the holder of a record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' makes CONE from the letters of once; the setter's 'City once' is a false phrase, as the city is still very much there.
explanation.definitionFit: A major German city on the Rhine.

clue.text: Exactly what is needed to support rising arts channel

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece that supports another sits below it
in a down clue rising means the letters are written upwards

parts.note: it means the very thing, as in that's it

explanation.surface: The perfect thing to prop up an arts television channel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' reverses ARTS to STRA; 'to support' puts IT under it in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow sea passage joining two larger bodies of water.

clue.text: Complete agreement in university issue

parts.note: a son is issue, meaning offspring

explanation.surface: Total consensus on a campus question.
explanation.definitionFit: Everyone acting or speaking together in harmony.

clue.text: Insubstantial name set in tiny letters

indicators.note: set in means placed inside another word

explanation.surface: A flimsy name printed in very small type.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letters' just refers to the letters of TINY into which N is set.
explanation.definitionFit: Thin and cheap-sounding, like something made of flimsy metal.

clue.text: Handy place for light music?

parts.note: handy hints at the hand's inside surface, and place at a courtyard, together naming the hotel lounge known for gentle string music

explanation.walkthrough: Hotel lounges called by this name, with potted plants, were famous in Britain for light orchestral tea-time music.
explanation.definitionFit: A hotel tea room where light orchestral music was traditionally played.

clue.text: Animal has hair on its head

parts.note: an animal's coat is its hair

indicators.note: head points to the first letter of its

explanation.surface: A creature has fur on its head.
explanation.definitionFit: A raccoon-like mammal from the Americas with a long snout.

clue.text: Assimilating and gaining interest?

definitions.meaning: engrossing, holding attention; also playfully a bank taking in interest

explanation.definitionFit: Soaking something up, and gripping or engrossing the attention.

clue.text: Bet, losing capital? Go easy

indicators.note: losing capital drops the first letter, the capital, of the bet word

parts.note: to gamble is to bet

explanation.surface: After a wager costs all your money, take it easy.
explanation.definitionFit: To walk at a leisurely, relaxed pace.

clue.text: Head back for a cask of beer

indicators.note: back means the word for head is turned round

parts.note: nut is slang for head

explanation.surface: Someone goes back for a barrel of ale.
explanation.definitionFit: A large barrel for wine or beer.

clue.text: Plan course before medical studies at one art centre

parts.note: a premed course prepares students before medical school
I is the Roman numeral for one
the Tate is a group of London art galleries

explanation.surface: A student plans a pre-medical course at an arts centre.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tate galleries in London and elsewhere are Britain's national collection of modern art.
explanation.definitionFit: To plan or think out something in advance.
